newsitem.title: USA: McCormick names Robert Lawless CEO.
newsitem.headline: McCormick names Robert Lawless CEO.

text.p: McCormick and Co Inc said on Monday its board of directors named Robert Lawless, 50, chief executive officer in addition to his responsibilities as president and chief operating officer.

The appointment is effective January 1, the company said. Charles McCormick Jr., 68, who has been chairman and CEO since January 1, would continue to serve as chairman and devote about 40 percent of his time to company business, McCormick said.
McCormick produces spices, seasonings, flavorings and specialty foods.
